# Mission Canvas

> Custom software built around your business, with ongoing maintenance and agreed improvements. Start with one workflow and a clear scope of care.

Mission Canvas offers Customized Software as a Service: custom software built around a business workflow, with scoped maintenance and agreed improvements. Each engagement defines the build, costs, deployment and ongoing care. Book a workflow audit: https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/


## Main pages

- [Mission Canvas: Customized Software as a Service](https://pretendhome.github.io/): Custom software built around your business, with ongoing maintenance and agreed improvements. Start with one workflow and a clear scope of care.
- [Find your first custom workflow](https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/): Book an AI workflow audit: one call about the job that eats the most time in your week. No contract, nothing to prepare.
- [Custom software and ongoing care by industry](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/): Custom software for your industry, shaped around your workflow with agreed maintenance and improvements.
- [Private AI software for small businesses: questions answered](https://pretendhome.github.io/faq): Answers to what owners ask about private AI software before an audit: what it is, what it costs, who owns it, and where the data goes.
- [How it works](https://pretendhome.github.io/how-it-works): How Mission Canvas turns your workflow into custom software, with clear boundaries and ongoing care.
- [Palette: a free local AI app for your documents](https://pretendhome.github.io/palette): A free local AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux. Give it one folder. It reads only what you allow, on your computer, and links every line to its source.
- [Pricing: custom software and ongoing care](https://pretendhome.github.io/pricing): A scoped setup and build, followed by recurring care. Final figures, responsibilities and outside costs are agreed by quote.
- [Your data and controls: custom software for your workflow](https://pretendhome.github.io/security): Agree deployment, access and AI use for your custom workflow, with responsibilities for ongoing maintenance and review.

## Industries

- [Construction job costing and fleet software](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/construction): Construction job costing and fleet software, customized for your crew with ongoing care. Job site, office and fleet on your own computers.
- [Private AI for schools: student lenses and parent summaries](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/education): Private AI for schools, customized and cared for: student lenses track observations, strategies, accommodations and CEFR milestones on your own machines.
- [Ticketing and access control software for venues](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/events-venues): Ticketing and access control software for venues, customized and cared for: online sales, the gate, box office and visitor records in one system.
- [Private patient check-in and scheduling software](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/healthcare): Patient check-in, scheduling and queues on your own computers. In progress: custom software and ongoing care scoped for your clinic.
- [Order tracking software for small logistics companies](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/logistics): Order tracking software for small logistics companies: orders, overnight checks and customer updates on your own computers, customized and cared for.
- [Invoice processing automation for small businesses](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/office): Invoice processing automation for small businesses, customized and cared for: invoices read, checked and filed on your own computers.
- [AI receptionist for small businesses: phone, WhatsApp, email](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/voice-front-desk): An AI receptionist for small businesses: phone, WhatsApp, email and calendar bookings, customized around your front desk with ongoing care.
